_about: Proton range references in liquid water for the MCsquare validation case. The reference is the NIST PSTAR CSDA range (pstar_values_mm, entered 2026-10-21); the fallback for energies not in that table is the Bragg-Kleeman fit R0 = alpha * E^p with Bortfeld's parameters, which reproduces the PSTAR CSDA range to within about 1-2 % between 10 and 250 MeV (Bortfeld, Med Phys 24:2024, 1997; 'Accuracy of parameterized proton range models', arXiv:1704.08854, Table 1). The distal 80 % depth of a pencil beam, R80, lies within a fraction of a millimetre of the CSDA range at these energies (detour factor about 0.998), so one tolerance covers both.

tolerance.note: 1 % + 1 mm against the PSTAR CSDA range; R80 of a pencil beam sits within a fraction of a millimetre of it (detour factor 0.9987-0.9989)

bdl_energies_mev: the vendored IBA BDL covers 100-225 MeV in 5 MeV steps plus 20 MeV; cases use energies on that grid
pstar_source: NIST PSTAR, Stopping-Power and Range Tables for Protons, material 'Water, Liquid' (276), CSDA and projected ranges in g/cm2 converted to mm at 1.000 g/cm3; retrieved from https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Star/Text/PSTAR.html on 2026-10-21 (table columns: kinetic energy, electronic, nuclear and total stopping power, CSDA range, projected range, detour factor)
